chapter: Ben Webster and Jim and Andy's
title: Raymond Scott's CBS band and Jimmy Crawford
summary: Raymond Scott used a metronome and earphones; Crawford's retort about his instructions.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Well, we're still on Jim and Andy's, which includes when you first came to New York and all the great band guys were there. Who were they?

Well, we started off with Jim and Andy's, I guess talking about Ben Webster and how I first met him. Later, of course, he went up to CBS and played with Raymond Scott's band. And that was a great band if you remember that.
Yeah, that was a great band. I remember that.
They had that drummer from Lunceford's

Jimmy Crawford. You know how Raymond always was, he had that metronome in the booth, and the earphones, and he would conduct with the metronome going. And he'd keep telling Jimmy how to play and finally Jimmy told him -- you know that story?
"Raymond, I swear, if I did what you told me to do, you'd make a circus drummer out of me."

And he said, why don't you and I go up to 125 Street, throw our heads back and relax a little bit. He said, you know, the trouble with you is you've got to relax a little bit. And he added something else.
: Yeah, what he could do while they were relaxing.
Yeah, some of the girls up there would help them relax. And knowing Raymond Scott, that's the most unlikely guy in the world to ever say it to.
